vc.title: No one can hear me
vc.description: Disable Advanced Voice Activity in Voice settings of Discord, and reload the app.

background.title: Background in themes not showing
background.description: Due to a recent Discord change, the themes chat background is currently broken for some users. The devs want to fix it but haven't been able to recreate the problem themselves yet.

ios.title: iOS Support
ios.description: Does ShiggyCord support iOS? No, but you can run it as a custom bundle by KettuTweak.

passkeys.title: Passkeys not working
passkeys.description: Due to the way ShiggyCord modifies the Discord app, it breaks the functionality of passkeys. To use passkeys, you must instead use ShiggyXposed, which doesn't alter the original app. Please note that ShiggyXposed requires a rooted device.

ftf.title: Failed to fetch
ftf.description: ShiggyCord tried to fetch bundle but couldn't. Try using vpn and see if it works. But if Shiggy still load successfully, ignore it.

stuck.title: ShiggyCord stuck on loading discord screen
stuck.description: Disable bundle injection in Xposed Recovery Menu (shake your phone). If it fixes the issue, enable it again.
